approval.mondayTask: SCR Monday desk (Monday 09:00, trawl + SMS, no confirm)
approval.rule: Every Monday at 9am UK this run fires on its own (same pattern as the New Order Agent). Trawl company OneDrive for info@southcoastrods.onmicrosoft.com via scripts/trawl-onedrive.ps1 â€” restart Windows sync in the background or use Graph; never prompt anyone to sign in. Pull new media@ catch reports only â€” never reuse a catch that has already been posted. If there are no new reports, fill the week from existing OneDrive SCR/ST pictures. Then SMS Graham and Stuart. One APPROVE covers every post that week. On REJECT, apply the SMS changes and ask again. Do not schedule until one of them approves.
